**Point 3 — where the owner's chosen option is recorded:**

DEC-096 and CAP-59.a say the owner "decides" among the six options (fix differently, narrow, split, defer, delete, continue) but do not specify a field that records *which* option was chosen. The owner's decision is committed as a decision register entry (a DEC-nnn record), and `gov close --owner-decision <DEC-id>` references that entry to unblock the ticket. The content of the decision record (which option was picked and why) is the owner's prose in the DEC itself — the sources leave the structure open. **Package:** the sources do not prescribe a machine-readable field for the chosen option; the decision register entry is the record, and its text carries the choice (DEC-416).
